title: InterviewSim: A Scalable Framework for Interview-Grounded Personality Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2602.20294v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Simulating real personalities with large language models requires grounding generation in authentic personal data. Existing evaluation approaches rely on demographic surveys, personality questionnaires, or short AI-led interviews as proxies, but lack direct assessment against what individuals actually said. We address this gap with an interview-grounded evaluation framework for personality simulation at a large scale. We extract over 671,000 question-answer pairs from 23,000 verified interview transcripts across 1,000 public personalities, each with an average of 11.5 hours of interview content. We propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework with four complementary metrics measuring content similarity, factual consistency, personality alignment, and factual knowledge retention. translated_title: InterviewSim：一个可扩展的基于访谈的人格模拟框架
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型模拟真实人格，需要将生成过程锚定在真实的个人数据之上。现有的评估方法依赖于人口统计调查、人格问卷或简短的AI主导访谈作为替代手段，但缺乏对个人实际所言内容的直接评估。我们通过一个大规模的、基于访谈的人格模拟评估框架来填补这一空白。我们从1,000位公众人物的23,000份经过验证的访谈转录文本中提取了超过671,000个问答对，每位人物平均拥有11.5小时的访谈内容。我们提出了一个多维评估框架，包含四个互补的指标，分别衡量内容相似度、事实一致性、人格对齐度和事实知识保留度。通过系统性比较，我们发现，与基于……（注：原文摘要在此处截断）相比，基于访谈的锚定方式在内容对齐和精确匹配的事实召回方面带来了一致的提升。
tldr: 该论文提出InterviewSim，一个基于真实访谈数据的大规模人格模拟评估框架，通过从1000位公众人物的访谈中构建67万余问答对并设计四维互补评估指标，证明了以访谈为锚定能显著提升人格模拟的内容对齐度与事实召回准确性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces InterviewSim, a scalable interview-grounded evaluation framework that builds on 671K QA pairs extracted from 23,000 verified interviews of 1,000 public figures and uses four complementary metrics to demonstrate that grounding in real interviews consistently improves content alignment and exact-match factual recall in personality simulation.
